Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Ms. Indu Sharma, Advocate for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. G.S. Negi, Additional Chief
Standing Counsel for the State of
Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate for the
UPNL/respondent no. 4.
4. Petitioner was engaged on contract
for discharging duties as Junior Clerk in
the Office of District Information Officer,
Nainital in the month of January, 2013.
He is aggrieved by his disengagement
w.e.f. 30.11.2023. The reason for
petitioner's disengagement, as culled out
from Annexure-4 to the writ petition, is
that the vacancy on the post of Junior
Assistant in District Information Office
has been supplied by regular
appointment w.e.f. 30.11.2023,
therefore, there is no vacancy available
against which petitioner can be permitted
to continue.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that there is one vacancy on the
post of Junior Assistant still available in
District Information Office, Nainital
against which petitioner can be
accommodated. She further submits that
in other district also, sufficient number of
vacancies are available, in the Office of
District Information Officer, therefore,
petitioner's disengagement w.e.f.
30.11.2023 is unjust and unreasonable.

2026:UHC:2718
6. Learned State Counsel, however,
disputes the said contention and submits
that there is no vacancy left in District
Information Office and the lone vacancy
has been filled by transfer of a regular
incumbent. He, however, submits that if
there is any vacancy available in District
Nainital or elsewhere, then petitioner can
make a representation to the competent
authority, which shall be dealt with as
per law.
7. The writ petition is, accordingly,
disposed of by permitting the petitioner
to make representation regarding his
reengagement. If he makes such
representation to the Director,
Information within ten days from today,
decision thereupon shall be taken by the
concerned Director, within six weeks
thereafter. If petitioner is re-engaged,
then the period during which he
remained out of service shall be liable to
be ignored while considering his claim for
regularisation.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 16.04.2026
Navin
